video.name: Acuarela
video.description: Turns your content into watery smoke. Smoooooke on the waaaaater!

video.name: Add Subtract
video.description: Manipulate the RGB channels of the clip by adding or subtracting to/from each individual channel.

video.name: Auto Mask
video.description: Creates alpha channel based on luminance or a color channel. This is very useful to get rid of black backgrounds in your content.

video.name: Bendoscope
video.description: Bend over and relax

video.name: Bloom
video.description: Makes the bright parts of an image glow and spread light around. Great for neon effects, glowing bits or hazy looks. GPU Intensive!

video.name: Blow
video.description: Smear parts of image

video.name: Blur
video.description: Blurs the image

video.name: Bright.Contrast
video.description: Adjust Brightness and Contrast

video.name: CRT
video.description:
Mimics old Cathode Ray Tube screens.

Works by squeezing the input texture into an "emulated" CRT resolution space, using 1 pixel to light up 1 R,G,B triad. Light emission is faked by a simple blur in that emulated low-res space.

Greetings to Matze <3

video.name: ChromaKey
video.description: Keys out a certain color

video.name: Circles
video.description: Creates circles of colors based on the content.

video.name: Color Pass
video.description: Filters out a range of colors, makes them greyscale

video.name: Colorize
video.description: Applies a color filter to the content which is either a single color or based on a palette.

video.name: Crop
video.description: Crops the content using pixel values. The cropped output can be inverted to create a frame look.

video.name: Cube Tiles
video.description: Creates cube and uses the tiled content to fill its sides.

video.name: Delay RGB
video.description: Delay per color channel

video.name: Dilate
video.description: Dilates the colors, creating a painterly look.

video.name: Displace
video.description: Displaces pixels based on luminance

video.name: Distortion
video.description: Distorts the image

video.name: Dither
video.description: Simulates shades and gradients using tiny patterns of pixels. It’s often used to give images a lo-fi, pixelated, or vintage look by reducing color detail.

video.name: Dot Screen
video.description: Combines the content with a dot pattern, creating a halftone look.

video.name: Drop Shadow
video.description: Adds a soft-edged shadow behind the content. It helps to create a sense of depth by seperating the content from the background.

video.name: Edge Detection
video.description: Finds the outlines of the content by highlighting areas where colors or brightness change sharply. The result looks like a sketch or blueprint.

video.name: Exposure
video.description: Controls how bright or dark your content looks, like adjusting the light settings on a camera.

video.name: Fish Eye
video.description: Warps the content in a curved, bubble-like way—like looking through a peephole.

video.name: Flip
video.description: Flips image horizontaly, vertically or both

video.name: Fragment
video.description: Radial fragmentation

video.name: Freeze
video.description: Freezes part of image

video.name: Goo
video.description: Oozing Goo Effect

video.name: Grid
video.description: This effect is very griddly

video.name: Grid Cloner
video.description: Clones the content into an adjustable grid with distortion and randomization parameters.

video.name: Hatched
video.description: Applies a hatched pattern to the content.

video.name: Heat
video.description: Fakes thermal imaging

video.name: Hue Rotate
video.description: Rotates colours based on Hue

video.name: Infinite Zoom
video.description: Creates the illusion that the camera is endlessly zooming into the content.

video.name: Invert RGB
video.description: Invert per color channel

video.name: Iterate
video.description: Complex iterative compositing tool. A cloner effect on steroids.

video.name: Kaleidoscope
video.description: Kaleidoscope mirrors and rotates parts of your content to create symmetrical, geometric patterns. It turns any visual into a trippy, repeating mosaic.

video.name: Keystone
video.description: Keystone stretches and skews your content so it fits properly on a surface that isn’t straight, like a wall at an angle. It’s generally used for fixing perspective distortion created by a projector.

video.name: Keystone Crop
video.description: Keystone Crop works similar to Keystone, but it removes the stretched edges instead of trying to fit the image into a warped shape.

video.name: Keystone Mask
video.description: Keystone Mask works similar to Keystone, but it creates a mask out of the stretched edges instead of trying to fit the image into a warped shape. This allows you to 'poke holes' into your content.

video.name: Kuwahara
video.description: Kuwahara smooths out your content while keeping sharp edges. It gives visuals a stylized, brush-stroke feel. Fun fact: the algorithm was originally invented for medical imaging of the heart back in the 70s!

video.name: LUT
video.description: Applies a LUT (Lookup Table) to the content.

video.name: Levels
video.description: Levels affects the dark and bright parts of your content. The Base sets the darkest point, the Midpoint shifts the balance between shadows and highlights, and the Ratio controls how stretched or compressed the range between dark and light areas becomes.

video.name: Linear Cloner
video.description: Creates duplicates of your content in a linear line, which can be distorted and twisted.

video.name: LoRez
video.description: Creates low res version of image

video.name: Mask
video.description: Masks your content using an image.

video.name: Meta Shape
video.description: Meta Image Effect, morphs from one shape to another based on luminance

video.name: Mirror
video.description: Mirrors the content over the X and Y axis separately.

video.name: Mirror Quad
video.description: Mirrors the X and Y axis simultaneously and symmetrically.

video.name: Morphogenesis
video.description: Morphogenesis

video.name: Noisy
video.description: Applies noise to the content.

video.name: OldTv
video.description: Like a wipe, but then as filter

video.name: Particle System
video.description: Creates a particle system using the content as base image.

video.name: Pixel Blur
video.description: Blurs the image

video.name: Pixel High Pass
video.description: High pass colors

video.name: Point Grid
video.description: Creates grid of points in 3D

video.name: PolarKaleido
video.description: Polar Kaleidoscope

video.name: Polkadot
video.description: Polka like you mean it

video.name: Posterize
video.description: Reduces amount of colours used

video.name: Radar
video.description: Creates a radar effect by masking the content in a pie shape.

video.name: Radial Cloner
video.description: Instantiates the content in a radial fashion. Allows for rotation and scale modulation.

video.name: RadialBlur
video.description: Radial Blur creates the look of motion radiating outward from a central point, like zooming through a tunnel or spinning in place.

video.name: Raster
video.description: Applies a scalable raster to the content.

video.name: Recolor
video.description: Palette remap

video.name: Reveal
video.description: Reveals the content over time using a grid pattern.

video.name: Ripples
video.description: Rippling video effect

video.name: SP Atom Dither
video.description: SP Atom Dither - texture layer effect: 12 ordered dither patterns (real Bayer matrices, halftone, hex, hatch, rings, noise), Size, luminance / per-channel, Levels, Contrast, Bias, sampled or tinted colour, Cells (downsample); Engine = real console palettes at their native resolutions (authentic / x2), Scan(lines), Spacing, Tint, Key (opaque router feed: dark becomes open), Mix. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Line
video.description: SP Atom Line - the 1D figure extended: Length/Position 1/Position 2/Angle/End 1/End 2; Signal along the line (flat/gradient/sine/noise/pulse) with Cycles and Rate (integrated); Read = the line samples the layer beneath (1D cross-section); Count/Gap tiling. One pixel thin, never touches the frame. Effect on a Video Router. No drives.

video.name: SP Chain Level
video.description: SP Chain LEVEL - the energy budget on a routed loop: Gain/Floor (base) + Curve/Lift/Ceiling, Key at the mix. Self-looping on a Video Router.

video.name: SP Chain Map
video.description: SP Chain MAP - per-pass zoom/rotate/drift/center on a routed loop, over the level base. Self-looping on a Video Router.

video.name: SP Delay Chain
video.description: BPM-synced multi-tap video delay line: 480 chained 1-frame Delays (8s tape), 60 taps every 8 links, 6 tap switches, alpha-over stack. Knobs: Taps 0-6 float (fading), Span 0.25-16 beats (farthest ghost; 16 beats true at 120bpm), phi toggle (golden scatter, gliding). + RGB: per-channel frame offsets R/G/B (0-16 frames, 0 = off) on the output.

video.name: SP Delay Performance
video.description: SP Delay Chain with half-width/half-height history textures. Same tap timing, span and color delays. Softer echoes; current frame and final mix retain full resolution.

video.name: SP Feedback
video.description: SP Feedback — one channel strip per insertion point: MAP/FOLD/TEXTURE/COLOR/LEVEL, all per-pass. v1.

video.name: SP Loop
video.description: SP Loop — feedback motion probe: routed input transformed per pass. SMART PARAM v4.

video.name: SP Loop FX
video.description: SP Loop FX — feedback motion probe: routed input transformed per pass. SMART PARAM v4.

video.name: SP Study Color
video.description: SP Study COLOR (chain) - Hue Step deg/pass, Sat x/pass, Invert flavor, inside the loop. Self-looping on a Video Router.

video.name: SP Study Delay
video.description: SP Study 3 DELAY v10 - 192-frame full-resolution line (3.2s @60fps), two chained atlases. Delay moves only the gap between start points; replay rate never changes.

video.name: SP Study Fold
video.description: SP Study FOLD (chain) - Mirror picker off/x/xy/radial-6 with blendable Fold amount and center, inside the loop. Self-looping on a Video Router.

video.name: SP Study Level
video.description: SP Study 1 LEVEL - energy budget alone: full level chain (gain/lift/floor/curve/ceiling/key/soft) on identity loop. Feeds on comp content only.

video.name: SP Study Map
video.description: SP Study 2 MAP - per-pass spatial transform: zoom, 3-axis rotation (Z in-plane, X/Y perspective), drift, center, over the learned level base.

video.name: SP Study Mixer
video.description: SP Study MIXER (chain) - the circuit element: Blend picker (max/add/screen/mix/difference/multiply) x Feed, live vs loop. Self-looping on a Video Router.

video.name: SP Study Texture
video.description: SP Study TEXTURE (chain) - Diffuse and Etch both live in the loop; Grain sets the kernel scale. Self-looping on a Video Router.

video.name: Saturation
video.description: Saturation controls how intense or vivid the colors in your content are—like turning the volume up or down on color. Lowering it makes things look more gray or muted, while raising it makes the colors pop with extra energy and brightness.

video.name: SearchLight
video.description: Creates a moving spotlight that highlights only part of the content, like a flashlight sweeping through darkness.

video.name: Shape Mask
video.description: Mask your content with the most common geometric shapes.

video.name: Shaper
video.description: Generates many different shapes by adding, subtracting and merging two different geometric shapes.

video.name: Sharpen
video.description: Sharpen enhances the edges and fine details in an image, making it look crisper and more defined. It works by increasing contrast around edges, which helps textures stand out and gives visuals a cleaner, punchier appearance.

video.name: Shift Glitch
video.description: Creates a glitch effect by randomly shifting horizontal and/or veritcal parts of the content around

video.name: Shift RGB
video.description: Shift, rotate or scale the individual color channels

video.name: Slice Delay
video.description: Slice'n Delay

video.name: Slice Transform
video.description: Slice Transform

video.name: Slide
video.description: Moves and wraps the content over the X and Y axis.

video.name: Snow
video.description: Snow simulation.

video.name: Snowy
video.description: Let it snow, let it snow, let it snow.

video.name: Solid Color
video.description: Solid Color

video.name: Sparkles
video.description: Creates sparkles on top of your content. Get your glitter going baby!

video.name: Sphere
video.description: Transforms your content into an extruded sphere.

video.name: Static
video.description: Layers static noise on top of your content. Use the opacity slider and blend modes for interesting mixes.

video.name: Stingy Sphere
video.description: Sphere with spikes based on luminance

video.name: Stop Motion
video.description: Stop Motion effect

video.name: Stripper
video.description: Removes or recolors strips of your content. Allows for multiple ways to modulate and animate the strips

video.name: Strobe
video.description: Strobes a solid color over the content with adjustable frequency

video.name: Strokes
video.description: Van Gogh in a box. Left ear sold separately.

video.name: Suckr
video.description: Sucks the content into the center.

video.name: Terrain
video.description: Uses your content for terrain generation, similar to the Line Scape source.

video.name: Text Animator
video.description: Overlays animated text on top of your content as an effect. Perfect for making text look more dynamic. It stays on top of whatever visual is playing underneath.

video.name: Text Block
video.description: Overlays text on top of your content as an effect. Useful for adding a label or message. It stays on top of whatever visual is playing underneath.

video.name: Threshold
video.description: Color threshold

video.name: Tile
video.description: Tile and skew image

video.name: Tilt Shift
video.description: Keeps part of the content focused while blurring others, kind of like using a miniaturized lens. It creates the illusion that real-life scenes are actually tiny models or toy sets.

video.name: Tint
video.description: Creates tint filter

video.name: Trails
video.description: Creates ghosting trails from the movement within your content. A feedback effect which works best with content that has an alpha channel.

video.name: Transform
video.description: Move, scale and rotate your content.

video.name: Triangulate
video.description: Triangular pixellation with some Sierpinksi fractaliciousness

video.name: Tunnel
video.description: There is light at the end

video.name: Twisted
video.description: Pixel twister

video.name: Twitch
video.description: A random combination of erratic movement, strobing, color shifting and blurring.

video.name: UV Map
video.description: UV Map lets you use an uv map image to warp and remap how your content appears on screen. The UV map tells the content how to twist, stretch, or reposition each pixel.

video.name: Vibrance
video.description: Selective saturation preserving midtones

video.name: VideoWall
video.description: Video Wall slices your content into a grid of smaller screens, like it's being displayed across multiple monitors.

video.name: Vignette
video.description: Vignette crops and softens the edges of your image to draw focus toward the center. It can adds a subtle cinematic feel and can help guide the viewer’s eye or hide the edges of a projection.

video.name: WarpSpeed
video.description: Helm, Warp One, Engage!

video.name: Wave Warp
video.description: Warps the image according to a waveform
